items.quote: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son.
items.claim: After the child grew, she brought him to Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son (adoption into Pharaoh's household).
items.actor: she (the child's nurse/mother, unnamed in this verse)
items.action: brought the grown child to Pharaoh's daughter, who took him as her son

items.quote: And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
items.claim: Pharaoh's daughter named the child Moses, saying she gave the name because she drew him out of the water.
items.mechanism: naming explained by drawing him out of the water (etymology given in the text)
